title: the matching-free Poisson set likelihood (phd 0.65, no recall term) given a full 4 u fine-tune and compared at a matched vertex budget with the equal-budget plain fine-tune on the same exact distance map

a.recipe: p16_train.py --design D7 --init e123_D7_r3_j1 --u 4 --lr 0.0005 --stem_lr 0.3 --warm_frac 0.4 --w rec=0 phd=0.65 (the E244.a0 recipe, exact distance map = loader default), seed 0 (seed 1 if the rule asks)
a.note: tau and vtx_r from the declared matched-vertex procedure on val250 (interpolation at vert100 14.3), then evaluated on VAL 873; held-out 623 frames reported too

c.recipe: j1eq: the same command with --w rec=1.0 on the exact distance map (E237 arm a, e24_j1ex_s0 / s1)
c.note: same procedure, its own val250 grid per seed

rule.note: KEEP only if Q a - c >= +0.010 on both seeds (and on the held-out 623 frames); CUT if Q a - c <= -0.020 on one seed; between -0.020 and +0.010 INCONCLUSIVE (add seed 1; TIE if still inside the band)

kill: NaN loss, the BN-derail guard of the trainer, or val250 lanes found 0.03 below the j1 start at 1 u; a run that shared the GPU or had a 1-minute load average above 6 during training is not decided (E244 was lost that way): repeat it
